headline: CoreWeave Sells 2032 Bonds at 9.625% Yield Amid 'Neocloud' Market Pressures
summary: CoreWeave priced bonds due in 2032 at a 9.625% yield, following wider credit default swap widening and market scrutiny over cloud computing infrastructure financing costs.
why: Infrastructure providers supporting artificial intelligence workloads rely heavily on debt financing, making their credit spreads an important indicator of sector risk sentiment.

impacts.name: CoreWeave Inc.
impacts.why: High borrowing yields and elevated credit default swap spreads reflect investor caution regarding capital-intensive AI data center debt loads.

why_moved: Substantial debt issuance costs and widening credit spreads highlight concerns over the sustainability of aggressive infrastructure spending in the cloud sector.
